other_conditions: Must hold a valid press accreditation card (for independent journalists)
Minimum of 5 years work experience in journalism
Educational qualification must be matriculation or equivalent
Must cover at least 50% of news or comments in newspapers, magazines, news agencies, electronic media, or be an independent journalist with valid accreditation
Spouse and two dependent children are included in the insurance
Son’s age up to 23 years (or up to 25 years if studying at a bonafide institution)
If affiliated with a private news channel, the channel’s telecast must reach at least 20 districts in Bihar
benefits_summary: Personal accident and medical expense coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per insured, with 20% of the premium paid by the media representative and 80% covered by the government.
